exposure: surgical procedure type (e.g., caesarean section, laparoscopic removal of ovarian cysts)
timing of surgery (regular day shift vs. outside)
cohort: 2508 patients who underwent gynaecological or obstetrical surgery at a tertiary referral center in Germany between January 2011 and February 2016.
finding: Caesarean section and laparoscopic removal of ovarian cysts were associated with the highest postoperative pain scores, with younger age, chronic pain, and surgery outside regular shifts identified as risk factors for higher pain intensity, while shorter surgery duration, peridural/local analgesia, and preoperative sedation reduced pain.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as one of the procedures associated with the highest postoperative pain scores.
